title: Text to simulation: four requests through one compiler, ladder, decision and replay
description: Four requests in plain language compiled into study contracts and run end to end: a steel wall cooled by convection (closed form vs immersed finite volume, 12 mm and 300 degC), a laminar pipe (Hagen-Poiseuille vs finite differences on the radial momentum balance), a cantilever beam (Euler-Bernoulli in plane strain vs immersed elasticity) and the wall again in physics_ai mode, where a surrogate is fitted to the solver and scored on designs held out of its fit. The script then replays the first run from contract.json alone. Every number comes from a closed form, a solver call or a value the contract records with its source; each study is decided by pinneapple_analysis.trust.TrustReport.
domain: heat transfer, fluid mechanics and solid mechanics from natural language
